classes.label: Entity
classes.description: The most general class; everything that exists or can be thought about.

classes.label: Abstract
classes.description: Entities that exist as concepts, relations, or structures rather than physical objects.

classes.label: Concrete
classes.description: Entities with a physical or causal presence in the world.

classes.label: Mental Entity
classes.description: Entities constituted by or dependent on mental processes.

classes.label: Proposition
classes.description: A meaningful statement that can be evaluated as true or false.

classes.label: Concept
classes.description: A mental representation that categorizes objects or properties.

classes.label: Belief
classes.description: A mental state in which an agent holds a proposition to be true.

classes.label: Relation
classes.description: A connection or association between two or more entities.

classes.label: Epistemic Relation
classes.description: Relations specifically governing knowledge, justification, and evidence.

classes.label: Agent
classes.description: An entity capable of intentional action and belief formation.

classes.label: Human Agent
classes.description: A human knower and epistemic agent.

classes.label: Artificial Agent
classes.description: A computational system capable of belief-like states and reasoning.

classes.label: Epistemic Source
classes.description: A basis or origin from which justified beliefs can be derived.
